intervals.label: operating
intervals.note: Terminal interval; the quote combines the two consecutive sentences of the page that give the start year and the switch-off date.
intervals.quote: Linac2 started up in 1978, when it replaced Linac1. It was switched off for the last time on 12 November 2018.

beam_energy.quote: By the time they reached the other end, the protons had reached the energy of 50 MeV and gained 5% in mass.

summary.plain: The straight accelerator that started every proton used in CERN's experiments for forty years. It took protons up to 50 million electronvolts and passed them to the Proton Synchrotron Booster, and it was switched off for the last time in November 2018.
summary.technical: Proton linac delivering 50 MeV to the PS Booster from 1978 until 12 November 2018; replaced Linac1 and was itself replaced by Linac4.
